# `assertion_01`

An `llvm::cast<circt::llhd::RefType>` applied to a `mlir::Type` that is not one, inside MooreToCore's anonymous-namespace `VariableOpConversion`: a `moore.variable` whose element type is an open (dynamic) array has no LLHD ref lowering, and the pattern called `createZeroValue` on the type the converter had failed to convert instead of bailing out first, so LLVM's own `cast` tripped its `isa<To>(Val)` assertion. It covers the `assertion` class through `_ASSERT_GLIBC`, and it is the C++-aware half of that pattern that catches it: the `__PRETTY_FUNCTION__` glibc printed is `decltype(auto) llvm::cast(From &) [To = circt::llhd::RefType, From = mlir::Type]`, which carries two `::` pairs and would not have matched a `[^:]+` function group. It also records a defect in 03-LLD.md 3.7.1 rather than hiding it: the two CIRCT frames below `__assert_fail` are `createZeroValue` at line 0 and `(anonymous namespace)::VariableOpConversion::matchAndRewrite`, whose normalisation cuts at the first depth-zero `(` and so reduces the whole name to the empty string, and the empty name is then skipped, so `fingerprint_frame` walks past the pass that crashed and lands on `main`. For this class the primary fingerprint is the expression and the site, not the frame, so the fixture is sound; the frame is recorded as the evidence it is.

Mined by `analysis/measurements/w09_attempt.sh` on 2026-09-14 from seed `b3b407b37bb2` (`test/Conversion/MooreToCore/errors.mlir`), observed at its first parent `87f131c0af7f` built against `firtool-1.143.0`; the same input at the seed commit does not fire. Tool `circt-opt`, class `assertion`, signal `SIGABRT`.

`stderr.txt`, `expected.json:assertion_site` and the frame paths carry the mining host's build prefix (`/home/adi/.cache/chia-pin-smoke/w09/wt143` for CIRCT sources, `/home/adi/.cache/chia-pin-smoke/w09/sdk-1.143.0` for the SDK), not the image's `/workspace/circt/` and `/opt/circt-sdk/`. 03-LLD.md 3.7.1 strips the build prefix before the site enters a fingerprint, so the prefix is evidence and never a compared value; the relative site is `/home/adi/.cache/chia-pin-smoke/w09/sdk-1.143.0/include/llvm/Support/Casting.h:566`.
